nom: TULA The Cult Classic Purifying Face Cleanser

avis.texte: No problems with the cleanser itself, but it causes skin "purging". I was unaware and it made me break out quite a bit before i realized and stopped using it.

Ive been using this off and on for years. Just when i try to con myself into thinking i dont need it.. 2 weeks without this product and im back to square one with acne again. This is the only product that consistently keeps my acne away with regular use. Theres nothing else like it. The smell doesnt bother me because i know the results with long term use. 1 bottle lasts me about 2 months.

It cleaned my face and what not but, I couldn't get past this putrid smell of wet dog… I thought it was me at first but then i tried a different cleanser and it didn't smell like that. So yea, not buying this again.
I love the cult classic cleanser! It makes my skin feel clean and soft with probiotics. It doesn't leave my skin dry I have combination skin.
I loved this Tula purifying face cleanser until now! I just repurchased this and the scent is very strong! I can still smell it on my face 2 hours after washing. Extremely disappointed! Returning.

I have sensitive skin and am prone to breakouts and dryness from certain products. This cleanser is gentle on my skin yet removes dirt pretty well. It does not strip my face. When it comes to removing makeup, you may need something a little extra.

I lovee that this makes your skin feel very clean. you only need to use a little bit. I have pretty sensitive skin andbthis works just fine. I was reading reviews stating that the smell is bad. I dont think so at at! it smells just clean. but people just have different tastes. might work for you or might not. works for me wonderfully ☺️

I have combination skin that burns very easily when it comes to new products so I was a little wary of trying something new. This product leaves my oily spots feeling fully cleansed and my dry spots unbothered! It worked great for me!
Cannot say enough good things about this brand! Very good cleanser, was a repeat purchase of mine for years!

I rarely leave reviews, but I just washed my face and this Tula cleanser just ruins my pampering facial routine time. The smell is so bad, it just makes me sad, lol. I think it's fragrance-free, which is probably the problem. It stinks! And holy smokes, do NOT get any in your mouth…I wanted to cry. It's so bad. It does leave my face feeling clean and I love my Tula glow sunscreen. I hate this cleanser and will probably use it to scrub my feet or use it as leg shaving gel to get rid of it. I do NOT recommend!

avis.titre: I would love to buy this again and again
avis.texte: This is the best cleanser ever! It's so gentle on my face even during my pregnancy! I'm a forever customer for sure ‼️

If you are someone who likes bubbles from your cleanser this isn't it! But it is cleaning promise. It doesn't leave my skin feeling tight like other cleaners and I'm not irritated by dry skin while using my therapy mask after cleansing.
Everytime I used this cleanser, my face broke out. Dont really command it for those who have oily skin.

The Cult Classic Purifying Face Cleanser leaves my skin clean and balanced without feeling dry or tight. It removes makeup and buildup easily, lathers well, and feels gentle on sensitive skin. A simple, effective cleanser I'll definitely keep using.

I got this after using a couple other Tula products I like. It seems to be a good cleanser, but the fragrance is overpowering. To the point where it leaves a weird taste in my mouth just from inhaling when it's on my face. I don't know why we need so much fragrance for a cleanser, and for a brand that uses "cleaner" ingredients I'm surprised it was formulated this way. I cannot use this product and am returning it - and it's honestly making me question how "clean" the rest of the brand's products are.

I love this cleanser, however, the pump on the large bottle is terrible. The pump doesn't work very well and takes more time than it should to get the proper amount of cleanser. I will purchase this product again but will not buy the large bottle.

I love this cleanser! I re-buy it and take it with me when I travel. I have an extensive skincare routine at home but when traveling I keep it simple, using this cleanser followed by the Tula moisturizer. I give Tula products as gifts, they are that good.

I got this as a sample and have loved it! I rarely buy any product after I've had a sample of it because they typically don't stand out to me, but I plan to purchase this one once I'm out! It makes my face feel so clean and soft after using it. I've been using it for a few weeks now and haven't noticed any breakouts or skin irritation.

avis.titre: Eye area irritation and not vegan
avis.texte: This caused me to gave dryness in my inderyee area and puffieness around my eyelids. I believe because it has milk and yogurt proteins. Im not allergic to lactose or these ingredients but another skincare product I used with milk ingredients did the same thing. I wish we would stop using animal products in beauty products!
I don't care how well this might work. It smells so bad I have a visceral reaction to it. Consider yourself warned

avis.titre: I would not recommend this product
avis.texte: I got a 1 fl oz for my birthday and I looked it up, saw it was popular, and thought "it looks like alot of people have gotten this so i'll try it. That was a mistake. I used it for probably 2 days sometimes in the morning and night. Now my face is either breaking out or has a rash. I thought it was my skin dried out because it felt like it and maybe that's it too. I would not recomend at all. 3 days later my face is a little better but not much. If this happens to you, be sure to use a non-frangrance face mousterizer. That's wahat im doing but I will probably also go to a dermatologist becuase I have a friend who is one. BOTTOM LINE: dont get product

It cleanses my skin but i question how well- even though I've used it for months. The pump head doesnt pop up fast. I feel like half of the product i put in the wet wash cloth stays in it so i have to use a lot.

I am not someone who is sensitive to scents, but this one is unbearable. I received a tube as a freebie for a larger purchase and was intrigued at the name of the product, "the cult classic". I assumed it must be amazing to have a cult following. The scrntis so overpowering, and not just because it has a scent, but because the scent is loke cheap drug store perfume from the 80's. So mucb so, I can taste it even after I finish using it. I think it was quite bold and and even phony to name this product "The Cult Classic". I am not that familiar with Tula products but thought they were super clean and fresh, but I cannot believe that to be the case. There are many other cleansers that are better and habe nice scents: Elemis Dynamic Resurfacing, OSEA Ocean Cleanser, Anua PDRN cleanser, Round lab cleanser.

This cleanser is overall pretty good, but the little plastic part that stops product from coming out of the tube broke on my container, which wasted so much product because a lot of it leaked out. This has actually happened to me before, but I thought it must've just been a fluke so I bought another one and it happened again. I attached a picture of my current one, which I just got a couple weeks ago. If the product packaging was fixed, I would definitely buy it again, it just upset me that I'm paying high prices for cheap packaging that will end up making you need to buy another cleanser.
I received this facial cleanser as a free gift and it's amazing! My face feels so clean, fresh, smooth and shiny(like glass skin). Will be purchasing soon.

avis.titre: To strong of a sent from me
avis.texte: First bottle that I've had for a while did it smell like this? I don't know if they added more of a scent, I can't handle a scent. It works thought

avis.titre: BEST Product I've Ever Purchased at Ulta
avis.texte: You have to try this to see how amazing your skin will look and feel. My skin is actually starting to heal and look so good!

This is one of my favorite face washes. I enjoy the scent and how it lathers up with just a dime sized amount. My skin feel smooth and it doesn't dry it out. The bottle size and quality is great for the full price, but I try to buy it every time there is a sale.
I use it day and night and it makes my skin feel so clean after using. I got my boy friend hooked on it too.

avis.titre: Be careful with it getting in your eyes
avis.texte: It's extremely hard to not get product in your eye here and there. This probroduct made my eyes red and uncomfortable. It did make my skin feel clean.

So im not sure you know what glass skin means but I thought it was a myth, spoiler alert its not. When i shower i use this face wash and i dont use anything else after. For the next couple of hours my skin is so so soft and shiny but not greasy. Its like glowy. I love this so much but i would recommend the scented one. Unscented smells so bad its not worth it. Overall super good product. My mom literally stole mine and shes almost 50. I dont know how it stacks with a longer skin care routine but for my mom and I who simply wash our faces it works amazing. Hope this helps!!!

I love this product so much I have been getting it for years thats why I finally got the jumbo. Unfortunatley the pump does not work like I thought it would. It feels cheap and barley lets you press down, not giving alot of product with one pump.
I perosnally like the scent of this wash and it leaves my face feeling really clean. It is super pricey which sucks because i do love this product.

Got this for my birthday freebie. It cleans just fine, but man...that scent! It's the worst smelling cleanser I've ever encountered and it's STROOOOONG. I can still smell it on my skin afterward. I'll use it up, but I'll have to mix it with another product to cut the headache-inducing, cheap bathroom cleaner smell.
I think this is a very ok cleanser. I did not notice anything groundbreaking about it, so for the price I probably won't purchase again. Also not a fan of the scent.

I usually dont leave reviews but omg this one i got to. It was my birthday freebie so I was excited to try this cleanser but one time use was it for me. The smell is so strong i could literally taste it, it smells like a Dove bar soap. Super super strong, im ok with scents but not this one. I will never use again.

avis.titre: Ii will continually buy this product

I don't know if maybe they changed their formula but this stuff smells horrible. I didn't finish the bottle I threw it away
The smell!! It was so strong there's no way I could use this! I'm so confused on how it's a favorite.

avis.titre: nice face cleanser, but perfume smell is too strong
avis.texte: This is a well priced face cleanser that rinses clean. However while I am washing with it, I tend to hold my breath because of the strong perfume smell. My rating is a three....a rating of one for the smell and 5 for the quality of the product.

I keep purchasing The Cult Classic because it really is superb,. It does a fantastic job removing the oils, pollutants, and makeup/skincare oroducts on my face without irritating my skin. I love the light fragrance the facial cleanser has, its unique and enjoyable.

I started using this product when I was taking a break from birth control and experiencing terrible hormonal acne. It was great for how oily my skin was at the time and did a good job at preventing bad acne breakouts. However, when I got back on birth control and didn't have such oily skin anymore, this product was no longer needed. It really dried out my skin and actually caused these rough sensitive patches around my nose and chin. When I stopped using it and went back to my old cleanser, they went away.

avis.titre: I have been using for ove
avis.texte: I have been using for over a year. This is the best clearing I have ever used. Skin feels clean with out feeling dry and stiff. Plan to keep using.
This product works so good no residue your face feels so clean. Your skin is so ready for the rest of your skin routine
Ive been using this cleanser since February 2025 and i have not had a break out sonce then. I'm actually falling in loce woth all od Tula products!
Deeply cleanses my face however it does take some time to take off since it is a gel.
The cleanser I used for YEARS was discontinued so I needed a new one. This has been great on my skin. I really like it!

This cleasner broke me out and left my skin with a tight and dry feeling after washing. It did nothing good for my acne or skin. It does not lather well and also has a strong and unpleasant fragrance that smells like dish soap. I have tried a few other products and they were all misses as well. I do not recommend any thing from tula. For the price point, you are better off buying a dermalogica cleanser that will give you much better results
tried this for a solid week and made the breakouts on my forehead worse. i also dont like that it doesnt foam up - skin doesnt feel clean.
I've been using this brand since 2021 and my skin has never felt cleansed and smooth!

I struggled with acne as a teenager, and when I became an adult, my acne went away. After I turned 30+ my acne came back because my hormones changed. I have sensitive, oily, acne prone skin, most salicylic acid products burn. I was using Peach and Lily prior to using this line and it was just okay i was still getting breakouts. So I decided to try Tula and take a risk. My hormonal acne is totally clear and gone and I've only been using this for two weeks now. This line works well for me, but it may not work for all skin types. So I would recommend purchasing the travel size just to try it out first.

I genuinely tried giving this face cleanser a chance but it was just not working out for me. Ive always had acne and im prone to breakouts , i kept thinking it was either my face serums or my face lotion but i came to the conclusion that it was my face wash. Made my acne 3x worse than what it already was. Will never spend my money on this brand ever again .
Omg i got bad freaking acne from this recently :( i switched to dermologica rice cleanser

I am 62 with very dry skin. This product makes my skin feel very clean without making it dry. I use the intensive moisturizer at night. Love that it doesn't have any cancer causing chemicals like some of the others I have used it has improved the firmness and elasticity of my face

What exactly makes this a cult classic? I mean, its not terrible. I feel like I have to rinse more than other cleansers to get the soapy residue off. I am pretty sensitive to smells and this one is obnoxious to me. It seems floral or something. It doesnt linger after rinsing, but I hate the smell while I'm using it. I won't waste my money on any other Tula products because I'm afraid they will smell similar. This is a "No" for me.
It's a great product in what it does, but it smells like wet dog I cannot get over the smell.

avis.titre: Lost count of how many times I've bought this!
avis.texte: There's a reason it has a cult following. Excellent cleanser!

Of all the facial products I've tried this one is the absolute best. Often in times after using a face wash for a period of time my face will start to react to it. I have not had a problem with Tula and I have been using their products for about three years.
Would not recommend not sure why it had so many good reviews but for the price i doant have a feel clean face and i dont feel like it helped with acne

This is my first Tula product and I love it. The smell makes me happy as it is light and fresh. I like how clean and soft my face feels after I use it. I use it twice a day and my skin never feels tight afterwards.

avis.titre: Would not recommend for acne-prone skin
avis.texte: I never write reviews, but I felt so compelled to possibly prevent this from happening to someone else. After using this cleanser for months, my skin went from mild acne (that I believed was caused originally from using Tula's Radiant Skin Brightening Serum Skin Tint SPF) to horrible cystic acne that I have not gotten since I was a young teenager. I changed my already clean diet, got hormonal testing, and spent a lot of money on other products to try to rid the acne. With no luck, I decided to get in to see my Dermatologist, who had to give me cortisone shots to get rid of the cyclic acne I had that would not go away. After talking with her, she urged me to stop using any Tula products as she felt very strongly they were the cause, and said she would never recommend the brand. Since I've stopped using the Tula face wash, my skin has gone back to how it was prior to using their products. I have no new breakouts, I'm just left with terrible acne scaring and discoloration from the cystic acne this product caused me. Would not recommend.

avis.titre: Wish I knew more before buying
avis.texte: Yesterday was the first time using the face cleanser. It has a smell like nail polish remover. The smell is so strong that it lasts. Unfortunately, I am stuck using it until it is gone because it was so expensive that I don't want to throw it out.
Tried this product and was hooked. Works also great with my Clarisonic. My skin is so smooth and soft after washing it with this Tula Face wash . I highly recommend it

I have rosacea so i've been looking for cruelty free products that are effective but don't irritate my skin and this one is great! I love the consistency of it, clean ingredients, and leaves my skin feeling cleansed but not stripped.

Have been using this for 5 years now and don't go a single day without it. I have sensitive, combo but oily skin and this is the perfect gentle face wash I have tried that is consistent. It doesn't dry my skin out or strip it.

avis.titre: strong scent and leaves a residue
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this cleanser as I'm searching for a new one. The scent is strong and smells like an old fashioned perfume. It isn't very sudsy. And it feels like there's a residue - hard to rinse off.
I have been going back to this for three years now. My skin has never looked so good and I am eternally sold.
great product love it the pump quit working after the first time. would buy the product again just not the one with the pump. This is a common product defect, the company is aware of the problem
This cleanser is amazing. It's tough enough to remove make up, dirt, and sunscreens, yet gentle enough to where my skin doesn't feel completely stripped of its natural oils. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: First time trying this cleanser out and honestly love it! It doesn't dry my skin out like some cleansers can. Leaves me skin soft and smelling fresh.

I wanted to love it. The cleanser is just "OK". I don't notice the smell as much as some nor do I feel that is strips my skin, however, expect to use your makeup eraser for eye makeup cleanup after using.

I bought this in the smaller size to just try it out, i see some people have had problems but for me i really do like this, its gotten off my makeup and made my skin feel clean, the smell is a bit odd. But i do love it, will most likely be buying it again!
So glad I got this as a free gift, bc I woukd return it if I paid cash. Smells so bad. Had to use it twice to get the make up off. Left my skin really greasy and sticky.

I have been using this cleanser every day for over two years. I liked how it smelled and how nourished it would leave my skin. I just bought a new bottled and it smells awful and my face feels stripped. Unfortunately, I will be returning it. Why did they change it?! :(

I wanted to love this as it had so many good reviews but this cleanser has ruined my skin. For starters the scent is horrendous and I just couldnt get past it. But also it has destoryed my skin barrier. I have NEVER had dry patches and now they are all over my face. DO NOT GET THIS. I can normally tolerate harsher products. This being marketed as gentle is a joke.

I got this as my duamond rewsrd bday freebie. It feels great howevee the smell is so so awful. It bas a scwnt of rose maybe and literally is like the kind of soap that my grandma used to have. And the smell lingers for a long time. Threw it away
This is my favourite cleanser. So gentle and my face feels so clean!! I will never go to another cleanser!! If you haven't tried you need to!! This is the GOAT!!

I've dealt with acne all my life. This face wash is hands-down the best one I've ever owned. It has helped to keep my skin clear after getting off birth control after 10 years, pregnancy, and now postpartum no plans to ever change my routine.
I love this product so much. I use it every day and I have been using it for years and have only gone through two cleansers. I highly recommend this product
This is a great product but you have to use it a few times for it to take off MAKEUP.but it does leave my skin fresh abd smooth!

I found this cleanser to be a tad more drying of my face than Purity by Philosophy, which is my current cleanser. It's a gel more like Cetaphil. The cap leaked out my product. I don't love it or hate it. I could use it, but already have something i prefer better.
This cleaner is amazing. My skin feels softer and not dry at all. I have VERY sensitive skin and this is not irritating at all.

The face wash works great however the carpet itself leaks, and apparently I'm not the only one that feels this way. I have a friend whose cap does the same thing seems like a design flaw however so many other companies make the same kind of design and never have this problem. I recommend the face wash, but not in this style container

The sample was enough for about two weeks of use (a little of this product goes a long way). I used TULA face cleanser every day and two weeks later I saw a noticeable difference in the tone and texture of my skin. I've been using TULA Purifying Face Cleanser ever since. This product isn't a miracle, but if you cleanse your face regularly with TULA Face Cleanser you will notice a definite improvement in the texture and brightness of your skin.
This cleanser is a staple in our household. We are both able to use it and it just works so well for any skin type!
I very weird about what I put on my face!! This stuff has been awesome!!!

It leaves your skin so clean but not dry or tight at all. It takes off all your makeup while still being gentle. Can't recommend enough.
I LOVE Tula products! My skin is very sensitive and Tula does wonders for my skin.
I absolutely love this cleanser. I have very dry, acne prone skin and I have been using this face wash for 3 years. This cleanser removes my make up without needing a make up remover!
I love my Tula face cleaner! It leaves my face feeling super smooth, soft and clean
I've been using this for over a year and I love that I don't break out . It cleans my face and leaves it feeling soft and refreshed .
After searching for years for the right cleanser, I have finally found it! It is so gentle yet effective.
I have used Tula in the past but stopped for several years. Decided to start again and am so pleased with the results. I don't handle fragrance well and the very slight fragrance does not bother me!

This cleanser doesn't quite get all my make up off but it does a decent job. My only complaint is the pump! It's horrible! Tula needs to redesign some of their product containers, ie anything they sell that you have to pump! I won't buy this particular bottle again because of the pump
